title: Archie Rose Single Malt Whisky $79.99 @ ALDI (Excl. QLD, SA)
body:
Deal: Archie Rose Single Malt Whisky $79.99 @ ALDI (Excl. QLD, SA)

[TripleCheesePizza] The rosebery location is a terrific venue and the cocktail making class is really fun
[undadog] ~$120 retail… jeez… thats so pricey compared to some decent scottish tipples…
[freefall101] It’s not worth that imo either, it’s just fine.
I’d rather go starward for Australian whisky, or gospel if you like rye.
[shiny1] Agreed. I tried both the rye and the single malt from Archie Rose and they were both OK. Got them at $90-$100 each when they were slightly discounted or with coupons. I didn't like them enough to keep around, so I passed them on to family. Starward Solera is a nicer Aussie whiskey in my opinion, but it is pricier normally. Twofold is very meh, but for the price, it's acceptable.
[undadog] the gospel was excellent but i picked it up last year for under $40… birthday discount + giftcard etc
that felt rightly priced… this even at $80 feels so overpriced tbh
[MELso] Picked up a bottle at my local BWS on clearance a couple of weeks ago. For ~$65 less 20% through Top Cashback, it was a ripper deal as the Archiw Rose single malt is rather good…
(Worth checking the BWS clearance list to see if there's any stock left.)
[werdplaya58] Same here, but it's like we've cleared out all the whiskey now. Might have to wait until tge next round of stocktakes….
[MrMaestro] I really like their Australian Malt Whiskey for what it costs so I’m keen to try this.
[Foodstamps] I tried to like this but found it had a strong ethanol after taste. Not bad, but not great. Wouldn't want to pay more than 80 tbh
[whichwhatwho] Just me or is Archie Rose horribly average with like…all of their drinks.
Is it just a marketing thing that they garnered a recognised brand name?
[Erwark] I think their gin is fantastic.
Can't speak to their other spirits.
[fantombloo] I tried a bottle of their rum a few years ago and I remember it being decently impressive. So I went to a tasting at their distillery and tried a bunch of their drinks and all were IMO pretty nice. Nothing blew me away but they were still nice. I'm not usually one for gin but even that was nice.
IMO they're doing it pretty well.
[GoldAlwaysGold] Is there even anything decent in Aldi Liqour section? Has gone downhill since 10 years ago when they had the good stuff from Europe like peach schnapps, now it's just no frills beer and cheap wine
